title: Daylight Ledger
summary: A Joby-calm daylight hero. The room shows through milky glass, and people at work read as warm-grey shadows in cols 7–12. An ink sentence and a light, muted second sentence stack down the left over calm milk. The audit's three terms hang off one vertical hairline bottom-right, and the Index Spine is born at the bottom edge as a right-angle joint. It trades today's dark HUD for quiet institutional authority.

reference.borrowed: Joby's calm, full-bleed cinematic frame, where one soft image carries the mood. A small headline sits at the left with a single quiet button beneath. Opposite it is a tiny three-line spec stack hung off a single 1px vertical hairline. Nothing else is on the screen.
reference.kelwin: Joby's dusk sky becomes the daylight frost: paper over the film on a paper film ground. The plate is set in cols 6–12 and feathered into the milk with a mask, so the man seen from behind and the colleague bent over the table read as warm-grey shadows, while cols 1–5 stay calm milk under the type. The mirrored half of the plate never enters the frame. The headline becomes the 92px Mona wide statement, two-tone by colour and weight: 'Revenue is an architectural problem.' in 430 --fg, then 'We design the system that solves it.' in 300 --fg-3. Below it come the 48×2 red rule and an 18px lede. The single button becomes the two doors in tracked caps: a 52px red 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' and an underlined 'TALK TO THE TEAM →'. The spec stack becomes the founder's bottom-right annotation as a quiet ledger: '■ A FIXED-SCOPE DIAGNOSTIC' over N·01 Ten working days · N·02 Clear findings · N·03 Actionable recommendations. It keeps Joby's vertical hairline as its left edge and is bottom-aligned with the doors. That vertical seeds the Index Spine, which starts at the hero's bottom edge at the col 3|4 gutter, with its right-angle opening rule and a 6px square joint. The nav is lockup left, right-set tracked-caps items with drawn Legora '+' disclosures, and an outlined 'AUDIT REQUEST ↗'.

motion: entrance (long durations, short distances, --ease-out): the glass starts as full milk and settles over 1.2s. The label fades in (400ms). The ink sentence fades and rises 12px (700ms), and the light muted sentence follows 160ms later. The red rule draws, then the lede and doors rise in. The ledger's vertical draws top-down (600ms), and each row rule draws left→right at a 60ms stagger as its text fades in. Finally the 6px joint appears, the opening rule draws from the spine to the right margin (900ms), the spine stub drops, and the '01 / 14 · ↓ SCROLL' cue fades in.
ambient: only the film: slowed to a 48s drift, with a silhouette crossing every 30s (first pass after 6s) and the frosted-glass grain. Nothing else loops.

interaction: a hovered ledger row fills --panel and its title shifts 8px right. The secondary link's ink underline draws in from the left (300ms) and → nudges 3px. The nav '+' marks close to '−', and the outlined nav action inverts to an ink fill.
on the live site: the spine runs uninterrupted from this joint to the footer, and its index column is sticky and crossfades as sections pass. Reduced motion shows the settled frame.
notes: Founder layout & type spec: lockup + tracked-caps nav with the outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗, red-square caps label, a 92px ink sentence with the light (300) muted second sentence as the one accent, the 48×2 red rule, a three-line lede, the red tracked-caps primary and the underlined secondary, and the bottom-right annotation as B's three-row ledger. The statement is B's sentence + muted sentence and runs to col 9 at 92px rather than the reference's cols 1–7 (kept: four lines is B's voice). Coherence pass — film: blur stays 10px with the base grain (.42); the paper frost drops from 34% to 22%, brightness 1.14 → 1.02 and saturation .6 → .7, and the plate moves down (inset 15% top, 30% left, top feather 11%) so the man seen from behind shows a clear head and shoulders right of the headline and the standing colleague reads as a person; a soft milk scrim inside .km-film keeps the ledger legible over his coat. The label is now 11px like every B label. Numbering: the foot's cue now reads '01 / 14 · ↓ Scroll' — the hero is the spine's first entry, so 02 Reframe … 14 Colophon run without a gap (the same section numbers A and C use).
